Romariian News Network
---------------------------
Government responds to the Wuloosya and Neue threats.
---------------------------
After the military threats of both Wuloosya and Neue were received by the Government, the Government has released an official and Publicly statement on these threats, and has sent them to both Wuloosya and Neue.

Here is a copy of the statement given to Neue:
---------------------------
[i]From: President of Imperium Romae Marii, Mario Mario
To: Whoever is in the Neuean Government

I, and everyone else in Imperium Romae Marii, are deeply concerned by your Mobilization against us. We would like to open talks between the Neue Republik and us.

We believe that airstriking our defenses will not make the situation better, nor will invading us. We believe peace is the better option.

Sincerly, Mario Mario[/i]
---------------------------
Here is a copy of the statement given to Wuloosya:
---------------------------
[i]From: President of Imperium Romae Marii, Mario Mario
To: Whoever is in the Wuloosyan Government

Let me get this straight, literally just one day after you gave the ultimatum, you started mobilising and PLANNED TO INVADE MY COUNTRY?? I have followed some of your stuff inside the ultimatum, I have done construction on the Memorial, I have canceled out future "colonial" ambitions, AND EVEN MORE.

Also, I CAN'T DO ALL OF THAT STUFF IN THE ULTIMATUM ONLY IN 10 DAYS WITH GOOD QUALITY, especially if my nation has rioters, extremists, terrorists, separatists, and god knows what spawning everywhere! I also don't know where my daughter is!

And a Regime change, let alone me leaving, will NOT be happening any time soon, it would only cause chaos and stupidity! AND I NEVER SAID TO THE RISF TO USE MUSTARD GAS ON APRIL 12TH, IT WAS JUST SOME RANDOM SOLDIER'S IDIOTIC IDEA!

An invasion of romariia will backfire, I tell you, even if my military just gets blown to oblivion, my people will fight back. Maybe.

(note: if there was an error when anyone in your government was writing the date in the voting thingy(like if it wasn't supposed to be April 21st, but, like, later) or the voting was to prepare for a POTENTIAL invasion and you wanted to see if everybody agrees, um, sorry for all of the above that i wrote)

From: Mario Mario
[/i]

[i](Note: the mini story below is an omnipotent scene, meaning that there was no cameraman, nor was this conversation supposed to be recorded. please refrain from mentioning this mini story as that would be weird because how the hell is someone supposed to know this happend if this was not recorded)[/i]

It was 7 am in Imperium Romae Marii. Everybody was waking up after a good night's rest, except for one person.

"Aaaugh Mama Miaaa!" groaned Mario Mario, president of Imperium Romae Marii, he was writing something on a piece of paper, "I have only 2 days left of this ultimatum, my daughter is still not found yet, AND MY NATION IS ABOUT TO BE INVADED BY 2 COUNTRIES."

Mario was writing a letter to both Neue and Wuloosya in an aggressive manner. The Neue Letter was more friendly, but the Wuloosya one, not soo much...

"'and you are a big jerk', THERE! I'm done!" Mario shouted with relief as he threw his pen into the air, "Time to se-!"

"Mario! Don't scream when everyone is waking up! You ruined my dream!" Groaned Luigi, who was still wearing his pajamas and his pajama hat, "What are you doing anyway?"

"Luigi," replied Mario, "I Just Finished our official statement on Neue and Wuloosya's military threats on us. Wanna see?"

Luigi then grabs the Neue Letter, and he liked it, "Hey! This one sounds pretty diplomatic and stuff! especially the 'We believe peace is the better option.' line!"

and then he looked at the Wuloosya letter, "Mario, is this a good idea to send this?"

"What's wrong?" Asked Mario.

"Mario, this sounds very harsh," replied Luigi.

"What? Luigi, do you think 10 days are enough to do all the stuff that was inside the Wuloosya Ultimatum?"

"No," Said Luigi.

"And look at the Negative effects the Ultimatum has caused! My people have lost trust in me because I was following the Ultimatum, more people became jobless, AND THERE ARE MORE EXTREMIST GROUPS!"

"And don't forget that they literally just say I'm doing nothing to fulfill the ultimatum, ONE DAY AFTER THEY GAVE ME THAT! An-"

"Mario, don't you think that their voting on April 21st was a voting to prepare, and the declaration thingy was made, maybe a few days ago? Not April 21st?" Luigi kindly interrupted Mario, "like you got the declaration a few days ago."

"Hey, that kinda makes sense, let me write a note on the bottom," said Mario.

"By the way, I got some news ab-" said Luigi, but was cut off by Mario.

"ABOUT MY DAUGHTER?!" Asked Mario frantically

"no"

"Oh ok, continue."

"Anywho, I got some info about the April 12th incident," continued Luigi, "turns out, the reason the RISF used mustard gas happened because someone, when filling up tear gas, thought mustard gas smelled like mustard, like the one for hotdogs, and that said person hates mustard!"

"Luigi," said Mario, "that is the most stupid info I've heard, and I'm gonna put it inside the letter."

"Mario, I think I should fix your letter." "said Luigi, as He snatched the letter from Mario's hands, then he spedrun on fixing the stuff inside the letter, "done!"

"Ooh, let me see," Said Mario, "Luigi you just made this letter make me look weak, what do you mean by 'pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, pleas, don't invade us!'???"

"aw camon Mario, that would make our neighbours feel bad for us!"

"Let me revert it back."

[i]A few rewriting moments later...[/i]

"ok, ok compromise," said Luigi, whose hands are already tired, "I will edit it, but not massively edit it, ok, Mario?"

"There we go!"

[i]later...[/i]

"There, finished!" Said Luigi, after fixing some stuff on the letter, "Using the computer was much better than using paper!"

"ok! I'll send them!" said Mario in an unnecessarily cheerful way.

"Mario, if Wuloosya declares war after they receive the letter, don't get angry at me, especially since you don't want to be deported but Wuloosya wants you to be," said Luigi, "but at least the Neue Letter was ok and Nice."

"Bah," Said Mario, "anyways Who was the name of the soldier who hated mustard? We need to send him to the International Court of Justice and bla-bla-blah."

"Unfortunately, I donno." Replied Luigi in an unfortunate tone.

Mario lands on the floor face-first
[b][i]
The end.[/i][/b]
